Amy (CS): Heads-up — Nicole reported that Rivermark's SIEM stopped showing request_id on Redwood audit logs after yesterday's cutover. Can we triage?
Nicole (Rivermark): Yep — our security team flagged it during ingestion. The logs arrive but the envelope.request_id is missing on ~15% of events. This breaks our correlation.
Amy (CS): Sample (sanitized) from their SIEM where request_id is missing:
```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-01T14:12:03Z","service":"redwood-inference","event":"request_end","envelope": {"user":"svc-rm"},"payload":{"model":"redwood-alpha","tokens":34}}
```
Jordan (Sec): KMS shouldn't strip JSON fields — it encrypts the payload blob. Two quick checks: (1) Is the forwarder doing any field-level redaction? (2) Did the audit schema version change?
Mike (Ops): I'm checking the forwarder config now. We pushed a forwarder update for rivermark on 2026-03-01 at 13:50 UTC that changed tag mapping. CLI to inspect: `rwdctl logs forwarder get rivermark --env prod`
Mike (Ops): Config excerpt I pulled: "map_tags": {"reqId":"envelope.request_id","user":"envelope.user"} — but the live mapping looks like `reqId":"envelope.requestid"` (missing underscore). That would cause `envelope.request_id` to not be populated.
Nicole (Rivermark): Ugh — that explains the mismatch. Any idea how that typo got introduced? This is affecting our compliance dashboards; renewal committee asked about stability.
Amy (CS): Noted — Nicole, sorry for the impact. We'll treat this as high priority. Jordan/Mike — can we patch back to expected mapping and run a reingest for the missing window?
Jordan (Sec): I can sign off on the change. I'll run a quick staging repro: create a sample audit event with `envelope.request_id` and ensure it maps through the forwarder to the SIEM intact.
Mike (Ops): I'll prepare an immediate hotfix rolling to the forwarder. Plan: 1) fix mapping typo 2) deploy to prod forwarder 3) kick off reingest job for 2026-03-01 13:45–14:30 UTC. ETA for the patch 20–30m.
AuditBot: Support ticket created #CS-8721 (Rivermark audit log mapping). Priority: P1.
Nicole (Rivermark): Appreciate the fast turnaround. For our audit team — will the reingest include original timestamps and signatures? We need an immutable trail.
Jordan (Sec): Reingest will only reprocess raw blobs; signatures/KMS envelopes remain intact. We'll preserve original timestamps and provide a verification digest.
Amy (CS): Action items: 
- Mike: deploy mapping fix (owner: mike-ops) — ETA 30m
- Jordan: run staging repro + verification digest (owner: jordan-sec) — ETA 2h
- Amy: coordinate with Rivermark and track renewal impact, capture feedback for onboarding doc (owner: amy-cs) — sync in 1h
- Eng: post-deploy check and reingest (owner: eng-runtime) — ETA tomorrow morning
Nicole (Rivermark): That timeline works. Please call out in the reingest notes that the KMS key is `alias/rivermark-prod-logs` and that we require the `envelope.request_id` populated for correlation.
Amy (CS): Noted — I'll add that to the ticket. Also capturing feedback: we should add a section to the Private/VPC onboarding runbook about forwarder tag mapping and a checklist to validate envelope fields during cutover.
Jordan (Sec): Agreed. I'll draft a short QA item: `verify envelope.request_id exists in 1000/1000 sample events` and add to runbook PR.
Mike (Ops): Patch applied to prod at 2026-03-01T14:05:12Z, rolling across 3 forwarder nodes. Running smoke checks against SIEM now.
Mike (Ops): Smoke looks good — I see `envelope.request_id` appear for newly generated test events.
Nicole (Rivermark): Confirmed on our side — request_id is back for new events. We'll wait on reingest for backfill. Thanks team.
Amy (CS): I'll follow up after reingest completes and attach the runbook PR link + ticket notes. Also flagging renewal-owner that this was an operational incident but we have a remediation plan; I'll write a short summary for the renewal packet.
Jordan (Sec): For traceability: I'll attach the verification checksum and staging logs to #CS-8721 once done.
Amy (CS): Great. Closing this thread for live updates; will post final postmortem and onboarding doc changes. :white_check_mark:
